title: 第六章 一条不回头的路【求收藏推荐和月票】
content_zh: 孙元急如星火赶回碧波城，第一时间就冲进了苏家。然后就傻眼了：苏家空了。所有能说了算的人，一个也不在家。“去哪了？”“不知。”“没留下话？”“没有。”“家里还有谁？”“还有夫人们。”“什么时候回来？”“不知。”“……”孙元直接无语了。苏家这是搞的毛线？太离谱了吧？神识搜遍了苏家，也没发现任何一个可以当家的，只好怏怏不乐的回了客栈。一路上，几乎将苏家八辈祖宗都骂翻了。没办法，只好自己来找方彻。来到方家之后，看到方彻正在整理鹿肉。一把剔骨尖刀，在方彻手里上下翻飞，刷刷刷……只是看了十几刀，就忍不住现身出来。因为这几刀，充满了信手掂来的灵气。虽然只是切肉，但是，出刀，收刀，游刃，颤锋，引尖，斜切……都有一种浑然天成的感觉。这让孙元心头火热。我发现了一个天才！——就是这种感觉。然后仔细看这小子的动作，眼神，更是满意。观察肌肉状态，血肉筋脉，隐隐透着一种晶莹。“这可不像是一般的乙级资质啊，倒像是甲等资质。”孙元想到这里，忍不住心头有些火热。武道资质分为甲乙丙丁四个等级。每一品再分上中下。丁等下品，基本一辈子也只能做个练武的普通人，力气稍大些，仅此而已。丁等上品，配以勤学苦练，也可以温饱富贵。到了乙等，基本就是世俗人眼中所说的天才了！而乙等上品，才是大宗门物色弟子的基本标准。而甲等资质，则是超级天才。甲等上品，万中无一。而甲等之上，便是各种传说中的体质了，便如刀骨、剑灵体、先天灵体，空灵体等等，还有一些女性特有的修炼资质。孙元本以为这個方彻只是乙等资质，随手放了个五灵蛊就跑了，压根没怎么放在心上。哪想到竟然不是。“苏家误我啊！”孙元心中愠怒。但想起苏家与方家向来是竞争敌对的关系，便也理解了。“既拍了我的马屁，又能毁掉方家一个天才，苏家的算盘倒是打得不错。难怪这小子的资质与苏家说的不同，定是如此。”孙元哼了一声。忍不住的有些怒意：“差点让我错过了如此一块良才美玉。”再感觉到五灵蛊在这小子体内活泼泼的，反馈清晰至极，更证明这小子的资质，能够让五灵蛊感觉舒服。这就代表着极品资质。心痒难熬之下，就直接跳了出来。“你帮手？”方彻看着孙元，撇撇嘴：“你谁呀？”虽然已经确定自己要从这方面入手，但是总不能这么轻易就范。俗话说得好，越难得到的，就越珍惜。“老夫孙元，江湖人称飞天刀王！”孙元很是有些自傲。飞天刀王，王级高手，这是自己明面上的身份，在这碧波城这等小地方，足够称王称霸！说出名字，绝对能吓人一跳。“没听说过。”“？？？”“而且我不喜欢用刀。”方彻翻着白眼，道：“再说了，我不认识你，这是我家，你怎么进来的？来人！来人啊！”“别别别……”孙元先是一阵狼狈，随即转念一想：“好吧，等你家人来做个见证也好。”“什么见证？”“老夫要收你做个徒弟！”“可我不想给自己找个师父。而且你才是个王级……”这句话，方彻说的是心里话。才一个王级……方彻有点没看上。怎么也要分量更重一些才好。你一个王级，在唯我正教的地位也没有多高吧？孙元震惊了。我一个王级，而且是刀王，想要在这种小家族收个弟子，居然这么难？你们家族顶高也就一个宗师，还是小宗师！距离我这王级，还有大宗师、武将、武帅，武侯四个大等级，等于是三十六个小品阶呢。你这小子凭什么认为我这武王就弱了？居然还“才”？“你还看不上我？我还未必非收你不可。”孙元哼了一声，抖手抓出一个白玉小塔，正是修行界测试资质的鱼龙塔。气死！如果这小子只是甲级下等资质，推荐到教里完成任务得了，让别人去收。甲中或者以上我再想办法收。现在先测试，别浪费了感情。“拿来！”“干嘛！”孙元哼了一声，很粗鲁的一把抓住他的手，按在鱼龙塔上，随即一只手按住方彻背心，一股灵力输入进去。一瞬间，鱼龙塔下面六层就直接亮起。直接就跨越了丁丙乙三个档次。“这么快！”孙元倒抽一口冷气。这才刚运行灵气吧？随即，第七层亮起，甲下了，接着是第八层闪亮，紧接着就是第九层直接闪亮，金光熠熠。“甲上了……这么快！”孙元咽口唾沫。接下来便是中的资质了。毫无阻碍！直接十层闪亮，爆发出炫目的金光，随即，光芒直接透射塔顶，金光冲出塔外！噗！鱼龙塔瞬间光芒全灭。废了。孙元呆若木鸡！传说级别，还要超出！凭资质测验神光冲破鱼龙塔！他这辈子连想都没想过这个世界上居然会有这种事。眼珠子几乎掉出来，顾不得这一个鱼龙塔的损毁，一把抓住方彻的手，打死都不放开了：“伱，你一定要拜老夫为师！”这特么……
content_en: Sun Yuan rushed back to Bibo City like a spark, and rushed into the Su family immediately.Then I was dumbfounded: the Su family was empty.All the people who have the final say are not at home."Where have you gone?" "I don't know." "No words left?" "No." "Who else is at home?" "And the ladies." "When will you come back?" "I don't know." "..." Sun Yuan was speechless.Is this what the Su family did?Isn't that outrageous?His spiritual consciousness searched the Su family and found no one who could take charge, so he had to return to the inn unhappy.Along the way, he almost scolded all eight generations of the Su family.I had no choice but to come to Fang Che myself.After arriving at Fang's house, he saw Fang Che preparing venison.A sharp bone-picking knife flew up and down in Fang Che's hand, swishing... After just looking at a dozen knives, he couldn't help but show up.Because these knives are full of spiritual energy that can be easily picked up.Although it's just cutting meat, there is a natural feeling when you draw the knife, put it back, move the blade, tremble the edge, lead the tip, and cut at an angle.This made Sun Yuan feel hot.I discovered a genius!——That’s the feeling.Then I looked carefully at this boy's movements and eyes, and he was even more satisfied.Observe the state of the muscles, the blood, flesh, tendons, and veins, there is a faint glint and translucency."This is not like an ordinary B-level qualification, but more like an A-level qualification." Sun Yuan couldn't help but feel a little hot when he thought of this.Martial arts qualifications are divided into four levels: A, B, C and D.Each product is further divided into upper, middle and lower grades.A low-ranking person like Ding can basically just be an ordinary person practicing martial arts for the rest of his life, with a little more strength, that's all.Ding and other high-grade people, coupled with diligent study and hard training, can also live well and be rich.When you reach the second level, you are basically what the world would call a genius!The second-grade top grade is the basic standard for large sects to select disciples.And those with first-class qualifications are super geniuses.A first-class top grade, unique among ten thousand.Above level A, there are various legendary physiques, such as sword bones, sword spirit bodies, innate spirit bodies, ethereal bodies, etc., as well as some female-specific training qualifications.Sun Yuan originally thought that Fang Che only had second-class qualifications, so he casually placed a Five Spirit Gu and ran away without paying much attention to it.Who would have thought it was not the case."The Su family mistaken me!" Sun Yuan was angry in his heart.But when I think about the competitive and hostile relationship between the Su family and the Fang family, I understand."Not only did he flatter me, but he was also able to destroy a genius from the Fang family. The Su family's calculation was pretty good. No wonder this guy's qualifications are different from what the Su family said. That must be the case." Sun Yuan snorted.I couldn't help but feel a little angry: "I almost missed such a talented and beautiful piece of jade." Then I felt that the Five Spirit Gu was lively in this kid's body, and the feedback was extremely clear, which further proved that this kid's qualifications can make the Five Spirit Gu feel comfortable.This represents the best qualifications.Feeling itchy and unbearable, I jumped out."Are you helping?" Fang Che looked at Sun Yuan and curled his lips: "Who are you?" Although he had determined that he would start from this aspect, he could not give in so easily.As the saying goes, the harder it is to get, the more you cherish it."I am Sun Yuan, known as the Flying Sword King in the world!" Sun Yuan was very proud.Flying Sword King, a king-level master, this is his apparent identity, and he is enough to dominate a small place like Bibo City!Saying the name will definitely shock people."Never heard of it." "???" "And I don't like using knives." Fang Che rolled his eyes and said, "Besides, I don't know you. This is my house. How did you get in? Someone is here! Someone is here!" "No, no, no, no..." Sun Yuan was embarrassed for a while,Then he changed his mind and said, "Okay, let's wait for your family to come as a witness." "What testimony?" "I want to accept you as a disciple!" "But I don't want to find a master for myself. And you are a king..." Fang Che said this from the bottom of his heart.Only a king level... Fang Che didn't like him a bit.It should be heavier anyway.You are a king, but your status in the Solipsism is not very high, right?Sun Yuan was shocked.I am a king level and a sword king. Is it so difficult to recruit a disciple in such a small family?There is only one grandmaster at the top of your family, and he is still a junior grandmaster!From my king level, there are four major levels: Grandmaster, Military General, Military Commander, and Wuhou, which is equivalent to thirty-six minor levels.Why do you think that I, the King of Martial Arts, am weak?He's actually "talented"?"You still don't like me? I may not have to accept you." Sun Yuan snorted, shaking his hands and grabbing a small white jade tower, which is the fish dragon tower used to test qualifications in the practice world.So angry!If this guy only has a lower level A qualification, he can be recommended to the teacher to complete the task and let others take over.If it's A or above, I'll find a way to collect it.Test it now, don’t waste your feelings."Bring it!" "What are you doing!" Sun Yuan snorted, grabbed his hand rudely, pressed it on the Fish Dragon Tower, and then pressed Fang Che's vest with one hand, inputting a burst of spiritual power.In an instant, the six floors below the Fish Dragon Tower lit up.It directly surpassed three levels of Ding Bingyi."So fast!" Sun Yuan gasped.Is this just the beginning of spiritual energy?Immediately, the seventh layer lit up, the armor came down, then the eighth layer shone, and then the ninth layer shone directly, with golden light."The armor is on...so fast!" Sun Yuan swallowed.Next is the qualification.No obstacles!Ten layers of light shone directly, bursting out with dazzling golden light. Then, the light directly penetrated the top of the tower, and the golden light rushed out of the tower!puff!The light of the Fish Dragon Tower was instantly extinguished.Wasted.Sun Yuan was dumbfounded!Legendary level and beyond!Break through the Fish-Dragon Tower with the divine light of the aptitude test!He had never even thought in his life that such a thing could happen in this world.His eyes almost fell out. He didn't care about the damage to the Fish-Dragon Tower. He grabbed Fang Che's hand and beat him to death without letting go: "You, you must become my teacher!" What the hell...
